punchline: One supervised 382-day fast was reported to have no ill-effects, in one patient.
thirty_sec: In 1973 Stewart and Fleming reported in the Postgraduate Medical Journal a 27-year-old man treated for obesity by a supervised fast of 382 days, with blood glucose near 30 mg per 100 ml and no ill-effects reported. It was one case, with no comparison group.
question: Which striking example are you leaning on, and how many similar cases do you know?
key_contrast: A case shows what can happen once, not what usually happens.
